title: OrchLaunch Toolchains
description: Toolchain definitions for OrchLaunch. Each toolchain defines compiler paths and environment for CMake.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE support

type.description: Toolchain type: system (auto-detected), unix (GCC/Clang), or msvc (Microsoft Visual C++).

cmake.description: Path to the CMake executable for this toolchain.

c.description: Path to the C compiler (e.g., gcc, clang, cl).

cxx.description: Path to the C++ compiler (e.g., g++, clang++, cl).

debugger.description: Debug adapter to use: gdb or lldb.

environment.description: Additional environment variables for this toolchain. Supports ${workspace} and ${orch} variables.
